The '''''Epoch''-class [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]''' was a type of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

It was produced by [[Shobquix Yards]] and modelled after the [[YT-1210 light freighter/Legends|YT-1210]] and [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]]. It was a sturdy class well suited to mining and ore hauling. The [[Resolve (Epoch-class)|''Resolve'']] was a modified ''Epoch''-class freighter.<ref name="AJ10" />
